notes.title: July Patch
notes.content:
Version 250708.11



We've gotten great feedback lately and wanted to get a fix out for some of the reported rough spots. This update contains the following:


Fixes & Adjustments[olist]
Storage unit not working - the storage unit stopped showing its contents for some players. This happened if you had purchased a particular wallpaper. Storage is working again.

Storage unit item count too small - we noticed that the quantity displayed in the storage unit interface was overly small. We've bumped up its size to make it more readable. Note: the quantity is only displayed when you have more than 1 of an item in storage.

DirectX 11 - A mysterious crash has been affecting some players. We believe this may be due to using DirectX 12. We've made an update. The game will only use DirectX 11. We've been unable to reproduce this crash ourselves. Hopefully this clears things up for those players. 

Negative days - Some players were reporting that they were seeing big negative numbers on the apartment choice screen (like Day -1255389). This was also showing up on the clock in the apartment. This has been corrected.

Biggie Meow - We discovered that Biggie Meow wasn't showing up in the street plushie kiosk. We've made an update. Biggie will now appear along with all of their buddies.
[/olist]

The same DLCs are available and can be bought in-app. Now that we have that behind us, all the goodness we put in there is rolled into this update.

New
Latin American Spanish Localization
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44400713/3a780fa806c5101ee6b70dee24d427a85b29171a.png

Plant Therapy now supports Spanish in addition to English. You'll be prompted the first time Plant Therapy starts to select your preferred language. You can change your chosen language anytime via Settings.

Locking items in place

You can now lock items in place to prevent accidentally picking them up. Locked items will glow red when you hover over them with the gloves. Lock and unlock items by clicking on the item to show its details and then clicking the lock icon.

Special visitors

Your apartment may be visited by a special visitor bearing joy and rewards. Look for them just after midnight.

New icons

We've replaced many of text labels on buttons with snappy new icons. Not only does this help with localization, they look great and allow us to add more options without crowding out the space available.

Variable placement
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44400713/c2aae9f86e276237afd333d103bd7e7b1ede34e9.png
We've greatly increased the wiggle room you have in placing items. This gives you the ability to align and nudge things just how you want on your way to your perfect apartment. This includes hanging pots. You can now adjust them vertically. Stagger away!

Tip: hold down the `Ctrl` key while you click if you want to snap an item directly to the dot you are hovering over. This can come in handy when you are trying to stack items.

Candles

Candles can now be sold. Clicking on them now brings up the familiar item detail box. From there you can sell, light and snuff your candles.

New lights

There is now a simple single bulb light for sale. You'll also get one in your starter Brooklyn apartment when you begin a new game.

Fertilizer Count

We've added a fertilizer count marker atop the fertilizer so you know how many you have left.

Quality of life improvements


 Deliveries and purchases are now more spaced out in your apartment if possible.
 Detecting the plant you want to water or fertilize has been updated to be less finicky so that there are fewer missed clicks.
 Claiming a reward will now trigger the next reward available for claiming so that you don't need to go back and click on the award button again.
 Street doors now glow to better let new players know where they can go. This glow goes away after you've visited that store twice.


Bug Fixes


 Flipping or selling the purple sofa (take advantage of that awesome resale value for some early game coinage) caused it to disappear sometimes.
 Some placement locations would errantly light up for a held item when you passed over them even though you could not place what you are holding there.
 A couple rare tutorial bugs were corrected that were very frustrating to those caught by them.
 Some laying issues of items were found and corrected.


Have fun with these new improvements!

notes.title: Storage and V-Sync patch (v. 240212.10)

This is a small patch with 2 notable items.

Selling and flipping your storage units
A request came our way to be able to sell a purchased storage unit. Honestly, we had wanted to add this earlier but could not figure out where best to put such an ability. We've made a decision and added the abilities to sell and flip your storage units. The controls to sell or flip your unit can be found in the storage unit's pop-up window (click on the storage unit).

Please be aware that all items in storage remain in storage after you sell your unit. You can access your storage from any of your other units.

V-Sync to correct possible display glitches
We've experienced some glitchy display issues on some of our machines, particularly when panning through an apartment. This shows itself as jitters, lags, or tears (an industry term to describe when a graphics card and its monitor are not synchronized properly). 

We exposed a setting that generally helps smooth these out. Turn on V-Sync if you are experiencing any of the above symptoms (there isn't an insane list of possible side-effects). The V-Sync switch can be found in Settings.

notes.title: Overly saturated display patch
notes.content:
ATTEMPTED BUG FIX

We've become aware of some games on Steam Deck and Mac appearing with super-saturated colors. We believe this may have been caused by some HDR processing in our game engine. We do not use HDR specifically and have disabled the settings that may have been led to this problem. This is our best guess at this time, as we were not able to reproduce this issue on our side.

Thanks to our community for reporting this to us!
